title: Vela project configuration
description: Schema for vela.config.json. Theme values are roblox-ts expression strings such as "Color3.fromRGB(59, 130, 246)" or "new UDim(0, 6)".

preflight.description: Neutralizes the Roblox defaults (opaque gray background, 1px border) on every className-bearing host element, so only explicit bg-* and border utilities paint. Set to false to keep the engine defaults.

colors.description: Replaces the whole default color scale. When present, theme.extend.colors is discarded.

radius.description: Replaces the whole default radius scale.

spacing.description: Replaces the whole default spacing scale.
